summary: The implementation covers most requirements with authentication, property listings, lead management, commission tracking, and UI design. However, partner registration flow is incomplete, property search/filter functionality is missing some requirements, lead status tracking lacks full status options, and commission breakdown details are not fully implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Partners can register with required fields: name, company, email, phone, license number
missing_requirements.reason: ProfileSetupModal collects name, companyName, contactDetails, and licenseInfo, but does not separately capture email and phone as distinct validated fields. The contactDetails field is a single text input, not structured email/phone fields.

missing_requirements.requirement: Partners can filter or search properties
missing_requirements.reason: PropertyList implements search by location and filters by type/status, but the backend getProperties query does not show evidence of server-side filtering support. The filtering is client-side only.

missing_requirements.requirement: Lead status can be tracked (new, contacted, site visit scheduled, negotiation, closed)
missing_requirements.reason: Backend defines LeadStatus with values: new, contacted, inProgress, closed. This does not include 'site visit scheduled' or 'negotiation' as separate status options.

missing_requirements.requirement: Partners can add new leads with customer name, contact, interested property, and budget
missing_requirements.reason: AddLeadForm only captures customerName. No fields exist for contact information, interested property, or budget.

missing_requirements.requirement: Partners can see commission breakdown by property/deal
missing_requirements.reason: Commission type does not include property or deal identifiers. CommissionTable displays amount, status, and paymentDate, but no property/deal breakdown is shown.
